Los servidores de la Agencia Española de: The servers of the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) register millions of technical requests every month. However, a log file does not explain how citizens use the portal: automatic requests, technical page resources and duplicate accesses are mixed with real queries about privacy and rights.
El reto de este proyecto (mi Trabajo de: The challenge of this project (my Final Degree Project at the IRTIC of the University of Valencia) was to transform this massive volume of data into a clear analytical tool: debug the real activity, structure it in a data warehouse and anticipate hourly traffic to plan resources in advance.
Para que el sistema resultara verdaderam: For the system to be truly useful, the solution had to respond to two complementary needs: provide management with historical visibility on the most requested procedures and anticipate peak visits to size the technical infrastructure.
Como autor del proyecto desarrollado en: As author of the project developed at IRTIC for the AEPD, my contribution covered the complete end-to-end technical responsibility: from the design of the dimensional model and ETL automation, to the development of Machine Learning models and the delivery of the interactive dashboard.
Diseñé e implementé el pipeline en Penta: I designed and implemented the pipeline in Pentaho to filter traffic from crawlers (bots) and reconstruct citizen browsing sessions, I modeled the dimensional store in PostgreSQL and formulated the time visit prediction problem.
Asimismo, entrené y evalué algoritmos de: Likewise, I trained and evaluated gradient algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM and HistGradientBoosting) with Bayesian optimization and rigorous temporal validation, finally building the dashboard in Power BI that was transferred to production and rated with a 10/10.
La arquitectura del proyecto resuelve un: The project's architecture solves a common problem in web analytics: servers generate a continuous stream of unstructured technical records that must be transformed before reaching the database so as not to degrade their performance.
Diseñé una estructura lineal en dos capa: I designed a linear structure in two layers on PostgreSQL. First, a staging zone receives and validates the raw log files; Subsequently, a dimensional warehouse in a star schema (Star Schema) consolidates the user sessions, separating the quantifiable facts from the descriptive dimensions (time, procedure and type of request).
Esta base unificada sirve como fuente ún: This unified foundation serves as a single source of truth for two independent purposes: it powers the dashboard in Power BI for management decisions and it provides historical data to models in Python for traffic prediction.
Si los datos de partida contienen ruido,: If the starting data contains noise, any scorecard or prediction will be meaningless. The servers not only register citizens: they receive constant crawls from robots and calls to technical elements of the pages.
Mediante Pentaho Data Integration, progr: Using Pentaho Data Integration, I programmed an automated pipeline (ETL) that discarded over 40% of the initial volume for automated crawlers and static resources. Additionally, it reconstructed people's actual visits by grouping their consecutive clicks into browsing sessions using 30-minute windows of inactivity.
Con los datos organizados por sesiones y: With the data organized by sessions and hours, the next step was to go from looking at the past to anticipating the future: how many visits will the electronic headquarters receive in each hour of the next day to size the technical infrastructure?
El tráfico web sigue patrones muy marcad: Web traffic follows very marked patterns: there is more activity in the middle of the morning than in the early morning, and weekdays are much busier than weekends or holidays. Therefore, I enriched the data with the official calendar (national and regional holidays) and with the history of visits from the last 24 hours and from the same time of the previous week to capture the usual inertia.
Entrené y comparé modelos de Machine Lea: I trained and compared Machine Learning models (XGBoost, LightGBM and HistGradientBoosting) adjusting their parameters to find the highest accuracy. To ensure that the forecasts worked in practice, I evaluated the models only by attempting to predict future days that had not appeared during training.
La gráfica inferior muestra este resulta: The graph below shows this result: the curve estimated by the model faithfully reproduces the peaks of maximum work influx and the nighttime decline, offering administrators a reliable reference hours in advance.
La inteligencia predictiva y los datos d: The predictive intelligence and refined data had to be easily interpretable by the AEPD management and technical team. For this reason, I designed an interactive dashboard in Power BI that integrates the historical analysis of visits and the model's hourly forecasts on the same screen.
El informe permite explorar qué servicio: The report allows you to explore which digital services generate the greatest influx (such as the whistleblowing channel or data protection guides), identify patterns according to geographical origin and compare at a glance the real demand against the expected one.
El proyecto obtuvo la máxima calificació: The project obtained the highest academic grade (10/10) at the University of Valencia and was transferred to production, currently operating as an official tool used by the Spanish Data Protection Agency itself to supervise its website.
Este proyecto consolidó una convicción p: This project consolidated a key professional conviction: the quality of the data at the source determines everything that happens afterward. A bad filtering rule on the raw logs distorts the scorecard and completely throws off the learning of the predictive model.
Comprobé también que en problemas operat: I also verified that in operational demand problems, anticipating the shape of the curve and the exact moment of the traffic peak is much more valuable for managers than chasing a minimum decimal error.
Por último, trabajar para la autoridad n: Finally, working for the national data protection authority reaffirmed that ethical rigor, privacy by design and traceability are not brakes on development, but rather the pillars that make an analytical solution credible and lasting.

En el transporte marítimo, ahorrar combu: In maritime transport, saving fuel is not as simple as sailing more slowly. Wind, waves, currents and the load of the boat constantly change the force needed to move forward. Reducing speed without judgment compromises the port schedules, but suddenly accelerating to make up time increases fuel consumption.
El reto de este proyecto para Baleària f: The challenge of this project for Baleària was to find the optimal balance: determine at what speed the ship should sail at each point of the voyage to minimize total energy expenditure, always ensuring arrival at the scheduled time.
Para que la solución fuera aplicable en: For the solution to be applicable in real operations, the recommendations had to act as a decision-making support system for the ground teams and the bridge, always leaving final control in the hands of the captain.
Dentro de un equipo multidisciplinar en: Within a multidisciplinary team at Baleària, my contribution focused on the area of Artificial Intelligence and optimization: designing the logic to transform sensor data into reliable consumption estimates and practical speed recommendations.
Mi trabajo abarcó desde la estructuració: My work ranged from structuring the navigation variables and training the energy predictive models, to the algorithm that calculates the best combination of speeds and quality controls to ensure that the suggestions were always safe.
Ningún algoritmo genera impacto si traba: No algorithm generates impact if it works in isolation. The key was to collaborate closely with the data and cloud profiles so that the models were supported by a solid and shared architecture, which connects from data capture to the user's screen.
Para que el sistema recomiende velocidad: For the system to recommend speeds judiciously, it needs to feed the models with reliable, real-time information. The architecture deployed on Google Cloud Platform brings together three different sources: the history of past voyages, the telemetry sent by the ship, and weather and maritime forecasts.
Todas estas fuentes convergen en una bas: All these sources converge in a centralized database in Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), where the dbt tool cleans, standardizes and validates the information. This guarantees that both the AI ​​models and the control screens always work on the same refined data.
Los datos brutos de un buque llegan deso: The raw data of a ship arrives out of order and at very different rates: the GPS emits coordinates every few seconds, the engines transmit continuous power and the weather reports are updated every several hours. To make them comparable, the first step was to divide each crossing into regular navigation sections.
En cada tramo separamos el gasto energét: In each section we separate the energy expenditure into its three main systems: propulsion (motors that move the boat), auxiliary services (electricity and air conditioning on board) and shaft generators. Breaking down the energy allows the model to understand the actual behavior of the ship instead of hiding it behind a global figure.
Además, calculamos el efecto del viento: In addition, we calculate the effect of the wind and currents on the ship's course, since a current in favor pushes the ship and a current against multiplies the resistance. Once cleaned and enriched, these sections feed the intelligent core of the project: the Machine Learning pipeline.
Con los datos organizados por tramos, el: With the data organized by sections, the challenge of the system is to resolve a practical decision: at what speed should it be navigated in each segment to use the minimum fuel without delaying arrival at port? To respond reliably, we built a continuous flow of Machine Learning and MLOps structured in three consecutive stages.
En primer lugar, un modelo predictivo es: Firstly, a predictive model estimates the power needed for each section based on the speed and sea state (wind, currents and wave height). Instead of applying theoretical tables, the model learns from real past trips and incorporates a margin of caution so that the recommendation never depends on an overly optimistic calculation.
A continuación, el algoritmo de optimiza: The optimization algorithm then analyzes the entire journey to find the most efficient distribution of speeds. If a section presents adverse weather conditions, it is worth slowing down so as not to waste energy and recover time in areas with calm waters. The figure below shows this principle: compared to sailing at a constant speed, the intelligent proposal adjusts the rhythm section by section, meeting the schedule with less effort.
Por último, la capa de MLOps garantiza l: Finally, the MLOps layer guarantees the reliability and traceability of the entire cloud system. Each recommendation is registered with its meteorological data and the version of the model that originated it. Before activating a new model, automatic validations are executed to check its physical consistency, allowing us to detect when navigation patterns change and retraining is necessary.
Todo este trabajo de datos y algoritmos: All this data and algorithm work only makes true sense if it reaches the people who make the decisions in a clear and timely manner. To connect the AI ​​pipeline with Baleària's daily operations, we developed an interactive web application in React that offers two specialized points of view: Operations on land and Crew at sea.
Para el equipo de Operaciones en tierra,: For the Ground Operations team, the platform provides a global and comparative vision of the fleet. It allows you to monitor the progress of each trip in real time, compare the speed observed against that suggested by the AI ​​and monitor accumulated consumption. Thanks to this perspective, the company can detect inefficiencies immediately and analyze the historical performance of routes with objective data.
Para la Tripulación a bordo, la interfaz: For the Crew on board, the interface is simplified to respond to the immediate needs of the bridge. The captain and officers receive a direct speed recommendation for the current leg, the margin of minutes with respect to the arrival time and the state of the maritime environment. This provides them with an objective criterion to save fuel while always maintaining navigation safety.

Decidir qué hacer un fin de semana deber: Deciding what to do on a weekend should be easy, but it often becomes a frustrating search. Cultural agendas are saturated with endless lists with brief descriptions and rigid filters that do not capture what really matters: the atmosphere of a plan, the company or the time of day.
El usuario experimenta fatiga de decisió: The user experiences decision fatigue before finding something palatable. NextPlan was born in the EDEM AI Master to solve this problem by uniting data engineering, Machine Learning and product design: centralize thousands of events and personalize them for each person.
La plataforma ofrece tres vías complemen: The platform offers three complementary avenues of discovery: a visual map to explore the city, an agile card (swipe) interface to capture instant tastes, and a conversational assistant that creates tailored itineraries.
Para sostener una experiencia de descubr: To sustain a real-time discovery experience without bottlenecks, the platform was built on a distributed and decoupled architecture on Google Cloud Platform, where each component takes strict responsibility: ingestion, analytics, machine learning inference, and web delivery.
Los datos transaccionales se gestionan e: Transactional data is managed in Cloud SQL, while BigQuery serves as the large central analytical repository where the event catalog, semantic embeddings, and millions of interaction events converge. The dbt tool orchestrates the analytical transformations, feeding in parallel the clustering engine and the Vertex AI agent.
Las fuentes de ocio públicas presentan u: Public leisure sources present a high disparity: generic categories, short descriptions and unstructured texts. To homogenize them, the Dataflow pipeline downloads thousands of events daily and enriches them using artificial intelligence with Gemini: it classifies the atmosphere or style of the plan (vibe), determines the appropriate company (couples, friends or family) and generates semantic vectors to find similar events by meaning and not just by fixed labels.
Al mismo tiempo, la aplicación recoge la: At the same time, the application collects signals of user interest: not only the direction of the swipe (discard or save), but the time spent reading the details of each card before deciding.
En BigQuery, los modelos de dbt transfor: In BigQuery, dbt models transform these raw events into clean 30- and 90-day affinity variables, removing duplicates and calculating the weight of each category. This modeling leaves the data ready for the next phase: the intelligent recommendation engine.
Con las variables de afinidad consolidad: With affinity variables consolidated in the data warehouse, NextPlan's intelligent core solves two challenges: sorting the best plans for the cards and answering complex questions in the chat.
En primer lugar, el algoritmo K-Means ag: First, the K-Means algorithm groups users into communities with similar tastes. To avoid locking anyone in a repetitive bubble where they always see the same thing, the recommender combines plans from the user's main group (weight 1.00) with suggestions from nearby neighboring groups (weights 0.60, 0.40 and 0.25). In this way, someone with an affinity for indie music also discovers alternative theater plays or related festivals.
A continuación, el cálculo final suma do: Next, the final calculation adds two deterministic impulses: a bonus if the event occurs in the user's city (+0.08) and an incentive if the date is close (up to +0.04) to prioritize immediate plans. In parallel, the conversational assistant with RAG in Vertex AI interprets open requests in natural language ("quiet plans for this Saturday") and directly searches the database for verified plans with real price and schedule, without inventing information.
Toda la ingeniería de datos e IA confluy: All data engineering and AI come together in an interactive React application that offers three natural ways to discover leisure: explore events on a dynamic map, train personal preferences through an agile deck of swipes, and request tailored itineraries from the conversational assistant.
Tras asistir a un plan recomendado, el s: After attending a recommended plan, the system closes the learning cycle through emails with one-click encrypted links (“I liked it” / “I didn't like it”). The response automatically updates the Feature Store in BigQuery without requiring user login and respecting the GDPR by design.

Este proyecto consolidó una certeza fund: This project cemented a fundamental certainty: language models and artificial intelligence only add real value when they are supported by robust data engineering. A conversational assistant without verified data hallucinates; connected to a structured warehouse with vector search, it solves everyday problems.
También demostró la potencia de combinar: It also demonstrated the power of combining techniques: classic clustering (K-Means) segments audiences quickly and economically, while language models provide semantic context, visual covers and natural language dialogue.
Diseñar un producto multicanal (mapa, ta: Designing a multi-channel product (map, cards and conversation) confirmed that not all users discover entertainment in the same way: offering the right way for each moment is what turns a complex technology into an attractive experience.
El comportamiento del usuario exige inme: User behavior demands immediacy: each swipe or long read is transmitted asynchronously via Pub/Sub to BigQuery without blocking the web application, ensuring high tolerance for traffic spikes.
Por su parte, la actualización del catál: For its part, the update of the cultural catalog is executed in a daily batch using Apache Beam in Dataflow, enriching the descriptions with Gemini and generating vector embeddings in a controlled and profitable way.
Evitar silos entre la navegación de la a: Avoiding silos between app navigation and AI models was a priority. Centralizing the entire history in BigQuery and transforming interactions with dbt into moving windows of 30 and 90 days allows you to calculate clean and comparable affinity signals.
El sistema no depende de una sola técnic: The system does not depend on a single AI technique. For quick navigation, the K-Means algorithm segments users by affinity and calculates Euclidean distances between centroids to suggest related plans without locking the user in a repetition bubble.
Para búsquedas complejas en lenguaje nat: For complex natural language searches, a RAG conversational agent in Vertex AI translates user intent into a SQL and vector query on BigQuery, delivering itineraries with real prices and schedules without risk of hallucination.

Buscar empleo suele convertirse en un pr: Looking for a job usually becomes an exhausting process full of uncertainty. Traditional portals publish hundreds of offers with confusing descriptions, contradictory requirements and exclusive criteria hidden between generic paragraphs. The candidate invests hours before knowing if their profile really fits.
A esta desinformación se suma una prepar: Added to this misinformation is repetitive and fragmented manual preparation: writing specific cover letters, researching corporate culture in multiple sources, and facing technical interviews without objective feedback or clear evaluation criteria.
El proyecto Alina nació en el Máster de: The Alina project was born in the EDEM AI Master to eliminate that friction from start to finish: transform unstructured offers into clear data, measure compatibility transparently and provide the candidate with a team of intelligent assistants who enhance their candidacy with technical rigor.
Dentro del equipo de cuatro integrantes: Within Alina's four-member team, my contribution focused on the comprehensive Artificial Intelligence architecture, multi-agent orchestration with Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) and the development of the asynchronous API in FastAPI.
Diseñé e implementé el pipeline de extra: I designed and implemented the CV extraction and structuring pipeline (PDF and DOCX), the explainable Match Score mathematical algorithm and the two-phase prompt architecture to optimize tokens and latency in the research and upskilling agents.
Asimismo, definí el flujo colaborativo e: Likewise, I defined the writer-critic collaborative flow for writing letters with strict guardrails of fidelity to the CV, coordinating with my colleagues so that the models were reactively integrated with the interface in React through streaming with Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Para ofrecer una respuesta rápida y reac: To offer fast and responsive response, we separated the web interface in React from the processing logic in the backend, built on FastAPI and Python 3.11. Based on this, we orchestrated four specialized agents with Google ADK using the Gemini 2.5 Flash model.
Las APIs de empleo gratuitas suelen trun: Free job APIs typically truncate descriptions to a few lines. To solve this, we built a dual pipeline: automated search combined with our own extractor in Selenium to obtain the complete vacancy, added to a direct manual paste option to analyze any offer without depending on third-party services.
Los currículums y las ofertas de empleo: Resumes and job offers are inherently heterogeneous and unstructured documents. A PDF can organize skills into tables, sidebars, or narrative paragraphs, while offerings alternate trade names, acronyms, and implied requirements. To enable rigorous comparison, the first step of the pipeline is entity normalization.
Mediante librerías especializadas (pypdf: Through specialized libraries (pypdf and python-docx) and extractor prompts with strict output schemes in Gemini, the system isolates technical skills (hard skills), interpersonal skills (soft skills), years of experience and work modality (remote, hybrid or in-person). Each technology is mapped against a canonical taxonomy that unifies variants such as “Postgres” and “PostgreSQL”, or “K8s” and “Kubernetes”.
Esta estructuración previa garantiza que: This prior structuring ensures that subsequent agents do not work on noisy raw text, but on comparable and auditable semantic profiles, laying the foundation for the mathematical calculation of compatibility.
Con los perfiles normalizados, el sistem: With the normalized profiles, the system deploys its intelligence in three complementary phases: the deterministic calculation of the adjustment, the activation of specialized agents and the optimization of latency in production.
Para evitar la arbitrariedad de los filt: To avoid the arbitrariness of opaque selection filters, the Match Score applies a transparent mathematical formula: it divides the covered and partial skills by the total requirements of the offer, adding an incentive if the preferred work modality matches. Each percentage point is explainable and auditable by the user.
A continuación, cuatro agentes especiali: Next, four specialized agents come into action according to the candidate's needs: one writes cover letters faithful to their real experience, another simulates technical interviews with questions and quantitative notes, a third detects what skills are lacking by suggesting practical courses, and the last researches the company before the meeting.
Para optimizar la respuesta de estos age: To optimize the response of these agents, we separate the model calls into two steps: first, the agent reasons and consults free text sources; then another call structures the final response. This separation reduced latency and token consumption and avoided syntax errors.
Todo el pipeline de agentes e inferencia: The entire pipeline of agents and inference is materialized in an interactive interface in React that empowers the candidate throughout their application cycle. Instead of offering a simple generic chat, the app organizes the experience into three specialized spaces: compatibility calculation, agent interaction, and performance monitoring.
El candidato puede inspeccionar en vivo: The candidate can inspect live the breakdown of their skills against different offers, consult the personalized recommendations of each agent (by downloading validated letters or practicing interviews with immediate evaluation) and check the operational efficiency of the system.

Alina consolidó tres lecciones esenciale: Alina consolidated three essential lessons about the development of systems based on artificial intelligence: first, that agents must have very narrow limits: a team of specialized assistants with specific tools far surpasses a generalist model.
Segundo, que la resiliencia en la captur: Second, resilience in data capture is a priority over any algorithm: third-party APIs fail or truncate information, so having alternative scrapers and direct manual entry is what makes a product viable in the face of real contingencies.
Y tercero, la importancia de la honestid: And third, the importance of algorithmic honesty: when a person's professional career is at stake, the system cannot allow itself to hallucinate. Designing critical agents that verify each statement against the reality of the curriculum is an essential technical and ethical requirement.
